who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent, lane proofs-1113
what: From 16:05 PST `ix shell blaze-vm --noninteractive` failed with `failed to open WebTransport session to https://52.37.172.228:8443/ixrpc/0: no response within 7s`, and a session that did open ended mid-command with `RPC session failed: the session ended or its path broke`. `ix ls` said the VM was running; the one session that got through at 16:08 showed a load average of 83. Eleven tries over ten minutes, one success. The run it cut was `blaze prove` on main`s exact tree after #2164, whose build and smoke had already passed there.
cost: the prove on main`s merged tree was not read back; every later VM step of the lane waits
cause: not known from here: the VM`s agent starved under load, or the path to its host
whys: a long command`s result was lost with its session
my helper scripts run the work inside the session that reads its output
a session that drops kills what it started
class: work whose life is tied to the connection that watches it
prevention: run each VM step as a systemd unit that writes its result to a file, and read the file with short sessions that may be retried (as the build queue`s long runs are meant to: rule work-in-ix-vms); the lane`s helpers (`tipvm2.sh`, `dogvm2.sh`, `provevm.sh`) do not yet. Not built.
workaround: retry; start the step detached (`systemd-run --unit=..`) once a session opens
